description:
This Java class is a Spring MVC controller named HomeController. It handles HTTP GET requests to the '/home' URL by redirecting users to the Swagger UI documentation page. The controller facilitates easy access to API documentation without conflicting with other root URLs,
and relies on Spring annotations to define its routing behavior.

classes.name: HomeController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller that provides a route ('/home') which redirects to the Swagger UI page for API documentation, improving developer access to API docs.

methods.name: homeFallback
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/home' and redirects clients to the Swagger UI located at '/swagger-ui/index.html'.
